subject: How to obtain different legend keys (lines and points but not both) for different groups?

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: How to obtain different legend keys (lines and points but not both) for different groups?
parts:
Dear all,

If I mix points and lines (as below) in a plot, the legend keys are
drawn as "points & lines".
Is it possible to have the legend key showing points for those groups
that correspond to points
in the plot and lines for those which correspond to lines (the
"Special group" in the example below)?

Cheers,

Marius


require(ggplot2)

df1 <- data.frame(Time=2001:2010, Group=rep(c("Group1", "Group2",
"Group3"), each=10),
Value=rep(1:10, 3)+runif(30))
df2 <- data.frame(Time=c(2001, 2010), Value=range(df1$Value))

ggplot(df1, aes(x=Time, y=Value)) + geom_point(aes(colour=Group)) +
geom_line(aes(colour="Special group"), data=df2)
## => the legend keys show lines with dots in the middle for *all*
groups
## how can one obtain only dots for Group 1 to 3 and only a
horizontal line
## for the "Special group"?

Okay, the minimal example in the post
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/2162b1fd89f81a15
shows this feature. Basically, one uses two legends. I got the idea
from this post: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/6720280/modify-legend-using-ggplot2-in-r

Cheers,

Marius
